msg_no_permission: Backups require administrator rights including the permission for sensitive files.
msg_no_backup_yet: There is no successful backup yet.
hint_group_core_db: Pages, posts, shop, users, settings. Saved as a consistent snapshot.
hint_mysql_dump: SQL dump of all tables %s as a consistent snapshot. Imported on restore, not copied.
hint_config_database: Contains the MySQL credentials in plain text.
hint_group_plugins: Databases and files of the plugins (data/ and uploads/).
hint_group_uploads: Images, files and galleries from the media manager.
hint_config_smtp: Contains the SMTP password in plain text.
hint_group_themes: Without node_modules. The core themes "administration" and "default" are replaced by every update.
hint_password: AES-256. The password is not stored anywhere. Without it the backup is useless. Open with 7-Zip, Keka or The Unarchiver, not with the built-in macOS/Windows unzip.
text_running: Backup running, this may take a moment …
msg_zip_missing: The PHP extension "zip" (ZipArchive) is missing. Backups can't be created without it.
msg_aes_unsupported: This PHP installation can't write AES-encrypted ZIP files (libzip too old).
msg_busy: A backup is already running. Please wait until it has finished.
msg_nothing_selected: Please select at least one source.
msg_no_files: No files were found in the selection.
msg_disk_space: Not enough disk space: the selection is %s, only %s are free.
msg_password_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
msg_plain_copy: These SQLite files could not be saved as a snapshot and were copied as-is. The copy may be inconsistent:
msg_password_reminder: Encrypted. Keep the password safe, it can't be recovered.
confirm_delete: Really delete this backup? The ZIP file is removed from the server, the log entry stays.
label_keep_count: Number of backups on the server
hint_keep_count: After each successful backup, older backups beyond this number are deleted. 0 = keep all.
sys_sqlite_old: too old for snapshots (3.27+), databases are copied
hint_system: The storage location is outside public/ and can't be reached by URL. Deleting the plugin also deletes the backups.
